notes: The page states Théorème2: faithfulness of the displayed association from fields of finite type over Q to profinite groupoids over Pi_Q. The literal noun is catégories; the following short form retains t.f./v.f. uncertainty. Neither des nor the awkward syntax is repaired. This is transcription, not verification of the theorem.

The upper marginal note says the theorem works over an arbitrary base and calls its nature geometric rather than arithmetic. The independent audit overturns the earlier characteristic-zero reading: after quelconque the ink is a dash and et en, followed by fait la dém. on the next line; no zero is written there. The parenthesis begins bien que pr la. Its compressed abbreviation, f-initial word and voie remain uncertain. The final arithmétique pure is clear; these are reading judgments, not a check of the assertion.

The proof opening is expressed with two diagrams. In the triangle the lower node is centered, both horizontal arrows are headed, the left p-prime diagonal is headless, and the right p diagonal is headed. In the square both horizontal links are equivalence signs, the left vertical is headed, and the right vertical is headless. The top-right argument is literal unbarred, unprimed eta; it has not been regularized to match the other three arguments.

The article before cancelled isom is literal l'e: both the high residual tick and the low e-loop survive. Carré is written above the cancelled noun. No unsupported order of the article correction has been assigned.

The lower paragraph uses chosen algebraic closures and an isomorphism between them. The first inserted map letter may have a prime; the first decorated K has an epsilon/f-like lower-right curl or no subscript. In the middle margin, barred Q and tilde Q are both present; cancellation of the first is uncertain. The note retains singular à celle and barred K-prime. The cancellation bien que stands between the parenthetical replacement and its continuation de telle façon.

Four locally matching open two-lobed extension letters are retained as calligraphic E; the independent G alternative is excluded by their open forms. The upper display arrow is headed; only the lower shaft has a head/shaft doubt. The bar on the source K stops before its prime. No proof check is claimed.

After sont égaux/egaux, the lower cancelled run retains s'agit/faut and conclure/conclusion. The raised cancelled replacement C'est sans doute plus is separately preserved, with doubt on its earlier two words. The two layers and strike are clear, but exact pen chronology and all internal letters are not.

The final main paragraph uses outer profinite groups pi_K and Gamma operators. The bottom note retains On doit se ramener au cas k=k-prime. Its crossed phrase remains uncertain between the abbreviated first reading and the independent shorter alternative. The replacement is pr une/prenant/par une; extension finie and unbarred Q are clear. No abbreviation is expanded by fiat.

No terminal full stop is securely present after the upper note's closing parenthesis, the middle note's barred K-prime, or the bottom note's Q. Stops following the heading numeral and two instances of hom are likewise not supplied. The actual stop in the initial hom. and the commas after fixée and Q are retained.

The heading is Théorème 2, underlined; no author page number or date is visible. The separate thin lower-left foliation reads 21 and is attributed to another/uncertain hand, not the main manuscript hand.
